scope: RESEARCH ONLY, no live code or predictions modified
basis: Stage142 full 2026 rank1/rank2 and all runner artifact; Stage136-142 repo code; BHA/HRI rules and other cited evidence
not_yet_proven: Prioritization is research hypothesis. Stage142 exploratory pillar checks do not establish causal importance, optimal weights, or profitability.

form_adjusted.meaning: Last 3–8 completed runs adjusted for beaten margin, field size, rivals, track, going, class, weight, pace/interference and reliability; never use finishing position alone.

real_ability.meaning: Previous-day HPR/form-performance figure with shrinkage for sparse observations; no future form or post-race RPR.

class_relative.meaning: Historical opposition quality, actual class/Grade/Group transitions, top 4 rival form and proven ceiling against today’s field; use same-code ratings.

handicap_value.meaning: Actual pre-race OR, today’s carried lb and legitimate jockey claim / WFA/penalty; compute theoretical net merit = (OR diff) − (carried lb diff); identify wrong-at-weights.

winning_mark.meaning: Prior handicap winning OR/weight, now-vs-then mark, recent close/strong efforts at same code, same conditions; signal only if prior mark verified.

weight_penalty.meaning: Actual weight carried, WFA, sex allowances and winner penalties in non-handicaps; compare like for like; do not assume equal weights.

fitness_cycle.meaning: Days since last run, 2nd/3rd run after layoff, within-season freshness, recovery burden; use learned type-specific effect.

progression.meaning: Slope of pre-race performance adjusted for strength and conditions; maiden-to-handicap and novice-to-open transitions; stable uncertainty.

speed_adjusted.meaning: Historical standardized speed/time and finishing sectionals if archived and genuinely pre-race; distance/going, track, wind and pace adjusted, never naked times.

pace_run_style.meaning: Observed previous running positions/sectionals and projected pace pressure for today’s field; no fabricated pace when unavailable.

draw_pace.meaning: Stall × track configuration × trip × field size × expected early pace; prior-only track statistics with smoothing; do not apply to jumps.

surface_affinity.meaning: Turf vs Polytrack/Tapeta (and historic surface changes) with horse/sire/dam performance; do not collapse all AW together.

going_fit.meaning: Previous adjusted ratings/margins on comparable going, breeding and surface when unexposed; avoid hard exclusion on unknown going.

distance_stamina.meaning: Distance response curve, best comparable performance, finish profile, sire/dam stamina, jump trip; account for pace and going.

course_profile.meaning: Right/left-handed, sharp/stiff, undulations, straight/run-in, obstacle complexity, surface and track-distance profile; avoid unverified venue homonyms.

jockey_conditional.meaning: Jockey skill by race type / track / obstacle or sprint, recent and long-term quality, experience, claiming allowance and horse-trainer partnership; shrink small samples.

jockey_claim.meaning: Verified apprentice/conditional claims deducted from carried weight only where applicable; separately assess rider quality.

jockey_steeple.meaning: Recent and lifetime completion/fall/UR performance of rider in chase/hunter chase, adjusted for mount quality and course.

jockey_flat.meaning: Jockey effectiveness at break/pace placement, sprint vs staying races and track/draw, adjusted for mount quality.

stable_profile.meaning: Trainer performance by precisely this race type, age class, first-time starters, transfer/reintroduction or novice transition; current 14/30d form shrunk to stable baseline.

stable_progression.meaning: Trainer success improving lightly raced horses in maiden→novice→handicap, off breaks and on surface switches, accounting for opposition.

pedigree_flat.meaning: Sire/dam/siblings for 2yo debut, early speed vs staying, going and AW surface performance; missing pedigrees produce uncertainty.

pedigree_jumps.meaning: Sire/dam point-to-point/bumper/hurdle/chase stamina and obstacle background; careful with unverified race history.

jumping_quality.meaning: Prior jumping error rate per obstacle jumped, trend, completion, late mistakes, efficiency and severity from comments; confidence adjusted for sample.

jumping_transition.meaning: Actual chase or hurdle experience, completion under that code, schooling/race experience proxies; do not treat hurdle clean runs as proven fence ability.

field_opposition.meaning: Strength and experience distribution of all declared runners, lightly raced upside, runner count, race conditions; learn relative ranking.

bumper_progression.meaning: Prior bumper/point-to-point evidence, same-type trainer debut performance, pace/finish potential and proven stamina; no Jumping pillar for bumpers.

hunter_pts.meaning: Verified point-to-point / hunter chase records, amateur riding and staying/obstacle exposure; explicitly mark source missing.

juvenile_maturity.meaning: 2yo or 3yo development, chronological month, sire/dam maturity, experience and comparative WFA; separate from older horse patterns.

older_horse_cycle.meaning: Career peak versus current level, repeated losing runs vs feasible OR mark, layoffs, course/going/trip return, age-related changes.

restricted_conditions.meaning: Eligibility details: auction/sales price restriction, novice winner penalties, sex/WFA allowances, claimed value, exact condition wording.

classified_net.meaning: Eligibility OR ceiling with largely level weights rather than handicap pounds; higher OR may offer a relative advantage.

seller_claimer.meaning: Low-grade form reliability, verified claim/sale conditions, class/trainer move and underlying recent speed; avoid inferred intent.

cross_country.meaning: Verified specialist banks/fences, cross-country course and extreme-trip form, obstacle completion and stamina; avoid using ordinary chase rating alone.

veteran.meaning: Actual age and repeated race cycles, old vs recent best figures, fitness, course, OR recovery; avoid simplistic age penalty.

graded_quality.meaning: Peak and reliable pre-race performances specifically at Group/Grade/Listed quality, collateral form, pace, stamina, allowances and penalty terms.

draw_context_bias.meaning: Prior-calendar-day course × trip × surface draw-zone winning performance against runner-count expected wins, with shrinkage and minimum 30 past drawn starters. Not a pace-interaction estimate.

NOVICE.when: Novice eligibility (including graded and novice handicap)

HANDICAP.when: Explicit handicap, including Graded/Listed and selling

PATTERN_GRADE.when: Group/Grade 1,2,3 or Listed with explicit text

STAYERS.when: Flat >13f or NH extended trips, calibrated by code

AMATEUR.when: Amateur riders, hunter chase or amateur race

FIRST_TIME.when: Verified first run in code (not merely no observed history)

SURFACE_CHANGE.when: Turf to AW or Polytrack to Tapeta regime

SELLER_CLAIMER.when: Selling/claiming type even if a handicap

critical_rules: First validate true GB/IE venue/country by race ID + date + source country, do not accept venue name only.
Classify country, turf/AW surface (and AW surface subtype), obstacle code, primary eligibility, actual handicap status, explicit group/grade and modifiers separately.
Never collapse Flat Group/Grade into OTHER; never replace known turf-only venue as FLAT_UNKNOWN without an audit; handle mixed venues via source evidence.
No market odds, SP or post-race rating in candidate predictor features; SP may only evaluate historical ROI.
Physical carried pounds and OR both preserved. In equal-weight pattern races, relative OR is informative but not an implicit handicap or mechanical winner.
Differentiate horses with genuinely verified debut from those whose form is absent in incomplete source.
Use past calendar day only, no future rivals form/collateral revisions until they actually occur.
Train specialist features hierarchically by parent type; share strength with broader discipline when race type is rare.
No effect can be called an established predictor until tested in out-of-time matched cohorts and prospective forward races.
Frozen D, D(c), Stage 137, Stage141 and Stage142 stay read only.
test_plan: QA source: venue homonyms; date/race-id jurisdiction; high-confidence official course/surface and correct obstacle code; collect anomalies.
Independent race taxonomy: surface × discipline × eligibility; preserve modifiers for handicap, graded, novice, juvenile, claiming/conditional and age/sex.
Feature provenance ledger per horse/race: when each input first became known, null, source reliability and use status.
Construct specialist features from pre-race history and only verified available sources; avoid fabricating pace, weight claims or pedigree.
Ablation A: unchanged Stage141 vs type-aware signal masks and nonlinear interactions with same model family and fixed training schedule.
Ablation B: specialist flat maiden/novice, flat and AW handicap, hurdle maiden/novice/handicap, beginner/novice/handicap chases, bumpers.
Ablation C: patterns and scarce types use hierarchical shared prior, compare with parent type instead of free model.
Temporal: 2022–2024 development, 2025 validation, 2026 through 10 Nov retrospective re-evaluation, then genuinely new prospective starts.
Report Rank1/Rank2 wins, calibrated win probabilities, logloss/Brier, ROI on priced SP coverage, distance/ground/surface and type, UK/IE, confidence intervals.
